beats.care: Eat at canteens and bakeries often? Watch for clean counters and covered food, and report problems to the FDA.
beats.what: The FDA suspended licences of 25 food businesses and 4 oil and spice units. Sophia College Canteen and Janata Bakery, Jogeshwari, are on the list.
beats.why: Inspectors found serious food-safety violations. At a Fortis Hospital kitchen run by Sodexo, they found cockroaches and rusted knives.

cards.body: 25 food businesses, like hotels, canteens and bakeries, plus 4 edible oil and spice units.
cards.caption: licences suspended

cards.body: A Borivali East sweet shop got a closure notice. It made sweets away from its registered address, with flies and unclean utensils.
cards.title: Sweets under check

opts: The shop gets a cash reward
It can't legally sell food until the FDA restores it
It only loses its online listing
cards.q: What does a suspended food licence mean?
cards.why: A suspension stops the business from legally running until it fixes problems and the licence is restored.

cards.q: How much do you trust your canteen's kitchen?

hook: Was your *college canteen* on the FDA's suspension list?

learn.t: One Jogeshwari bakery scored just 28 out of 88 in its FDA inspection, about 32%.

sources.name: Free Press Journal
sources.title: Maharashtra FDA Suspends 29 Food Licences Including Sophia College Canteen; Cockroaches Found In Fortis Hospital Kitchen

tldr: Maharashtra's FDA suspended 29 food licences after inspections, including Sophia College's canteen and a Mumbai bakery.
